correctness.rationale: For G=direct sum of finite cyclic p-power summands, any commuting k-tuple of idempotents determines mutually orthogonal 2^k color projections with images giving an internal labeled decomposition, and conversely. Aut(G) acts transitively on each fixed allocation type, product of component automorphisms is the stabilizer, giving exact integer ratios. Automorphism order follows from Hom counts and mod-p block invertibility; Stirling inversion removes repeated idempotents; maximal Boolean families have 2^n members. Cross-color min(a,b) exponents are independent of a unique strictly largest exponent, establishing full T_k invisibility; rank-two graph is K2 joined to p^(2a) edges. Independently enumerated all endomorphisms for p=2 and p=3 with type (1,2), confirming T1/T2/T3=(10,52,232) and (20,112,512). Infinite coverage is by algebraic proof, not enumeration.
